task.name: Artifact Retention Policy Enforcement
task.description: Review the repository-level GitHub Actions artifact and log retention setting for explicitly covered repositories and surface only repositories whose configured retention days fall outside the operator-approved range without an already tracked or explicitly accepted exception.
task.intent: Reduce storage-governance exposure from noncompliant Actions artifact retention settings while avoiding duplicate operator attention for settings that are already tracked or explicitly excepted.
activationConditions: A covered repository is evaluated within the evidence window against an operator-approved minimum and maximum Actions artifact retention period.
Authoritative repository Actions settings show that the configured artifact and log retention days fall outside the approved range.
requiredEffects: Each novel finding identifies the repository, configured retention days, approved range, direction of noncompliance, and authoritative settings evidence.
Operators can accept, reject, or resolve each finding using repository-linked settings, remediation, or exception evidence.
noopConditions: Every covered repository's configured Actions artifact and log retention days fall within its approved range.
Every supported noncompliant-retention finding is already tracked or covered by a current explicit exception.
successConditions: Supported noncompliant-retention findings receive accepted settings-remediation evidence or an explicit operator dismissal within 14 days of the workflow run.
Compliant settings and current accepted exceptions create no duplicate operator attention.
uncertainties: Repository policy may intentionally require a shorter or longer range than the organization default for regulated evidence or data-minimization obligations.
The repository settings API may be unavailable or insufficient to distinguish an inaccessible setting from a noncompliant value.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported, novel noncompliant artifact-retention findings assigned to the run that are remediated or explicitly dismissed within 14 days.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated supported noncompliant artifact-retention findings it assigns for explicitly covered repositories.
acceptedEvidence: Authoritative repository Actions settings showing that artifact and log retention days are within the approved range before the evidence cutoff.
A closed repository-linked tracking record or current exception record that explicitly marks the finding resolved, dismissed, or accepted by an authorized operator.
evidenceRepositories: The control repository in which the workflow ran.
Each explicitly covered repository to which an assigned finding applies.

metric.name: resolved-supported-artifact-retention-findings
metric.formula: remediated-or-dismissed supported noncompliant artifact-retention findings / supported novel noncompliant artifact-retention findings assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: 14 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported novel noncompliant artifact-retention finding was assigned and none has accepted remediation or dismissal evidence by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned finding set, approved retention range, or required authoritative repository Actions settings evidence cannot be read.

rows.finding-summary: Configured retention is 120 days; the approved range is 14–90 days, so the setting is 30 days above policy.

rows.outcome-summary: Repository settings evidence records an authorized 90-day retention value.
